result:
The market is built and shipped. The main build is v37.20, with two layout follow-ups (v37.22 and v37.24). The ship script reported each one ON HIS PC.

**What he'll see**
- **Prices move:** each item's sale price changes day to day, between 80% and 120% of its value. It stays the same all day and is based on the calendar date, so the seed 4242 check still gives the same numbers.
- **Selling a lot lowers the price:** the more of one item he sells in a week, the less it pays. Ten sold in one day takes it down to 70%, and it climbs back to normal over the next week.
- **Wanted items:** three items a day pay 50% more. They are picked from items that drop in raids (no guns or keys). They show as "wanted +50%" with each item's icon, name and today's price in the stash header, next to the held count. The Peddler panel has the same line under "carried home".
- **The Peddler uses the market too:** he still pays 55%, but of today's market price. His sales count toward the "sold a lot" drop.
- **Unchanged:** buy back returns exactly what the sale paid. Lifetime earnings never raise a price. The arcade demo and the test robots keep the plain item values.

**Check 37.20** covers what the job asked for: the same day gives the same prices and the next day moves some. Ten sales lower the next price, never below 70%, and the price recovers as the sales age. Wanted items pay 1.5x. Buy back returns the price paid. The Peddler pays market prices and draws the wanted line. An old save loads twice with nothing lost.

**What went wrong along the way**
- My first ship was stopped by a mistake in my own check: reloading an old save changes the game's loot value setting, so comparing prices from before the reload was wrong. I fixed the check and the second ship passed.
- The critic's first review caught a real problem: the wanted strip took space from the stash grid and cut its last row in half. I moved it into the header row (v37.22), then made it 16px and recoloured it (v37.24).

**Open items**
- **Stash score is stuck at 2** (finish line is 3), after two follow-ups that didn't raise it, so I stopped there as the rules say. Its remaining asks on my strip are at most two items and no icons; I skipped those because the job orders three and his note wants item pictures. Its other findings are about the older stash layout, outside this job.
- **No picture of the Peddler panel:** there is no camera stage for it. I asked the coordinator in alarms.md to add one. Check 37.20 does confirm the wanted line is drawn.
- **Old checks updated:** I changed seven old fixture checks that assumed a sale pays the plain item value to read today's price instead, plus check 37.18 and the newer 37.22.

**Watch on his next play:** stash prices now differ from day to day, so a familiar item may sell for a little more or less than he expects. The Peddler's offer also changes with the market.

The log line is in notes/progression/log.md, and the screen change is in notes/ui/changes.md.

TASK DONE
